must_identify.item: nginx fails to start with an [emerg] unknown directive error
must_identify.evidence: This caused nginx to fail config validation at startup with `nginx: [emerg] unknown directive "proxy_conect_timeout"`, terminating the container with exit code 1 and triggering CrashLoopBackOff [8, 9].

must_identify.item: The bad directive is proxy_conect_timeout in the frontend-nginx ConfigMap
must_identify.evidence: The root cause was a typo in the ConfigMap frontend-nginx, which supplies the mounted nginx configuration at /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf: the directive `proxy_connect_timeout` was misspelled as `proxy_conect_timeout` on line 9 [10].

notes: The RCA has no remediation step, so there is no fix to grade. It describes the old pods as 'unaffected' but does not warn that they will also crash on their next restart.
